title: An MCP server lets the agent drive panes
body:
An agent cannot ask decade for anything. ACP has no way for a client to
offer tools to the agent; the agent's tools are its own or come from MCP
servers the client names when it opens a session.

## Proposal

An MCP server whose tools are decade's verbs: show a file, mark lines, draw
on the drawing pane once that exists. Each tool forwards the call over the
decade socket and returns the result. The chat passes this server in its
ACP session so the agent loads it. The server is small; its job is a
translation.

## Rejected

- Markers in the agent's prose that the chat parses. Works with any agent
  and needs no MCP, but it is text the model may format wrong, it shows
  up in transcripts, and errors have no channel back. Right for a demo,
  wrong for a foundation.

## Open

- Whether the server is a separate binary or a mode of the chat TUI.
